## Experiment

```{r}
library(ggbrat)
library(ggplot2)

yeo <- load_atlas("Yeo2011_7Networks_N1000")


'yeo$atlas |> #<<
  mutate(row = row_number()) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(layout = "fixed") + #<<
  facet_wrap(~region) + #<<
  geom_sf(fill = "red") + #<<
  theme_void()' |> 
  ggram::ggram(code = _, title = "Exploring the Yeo brain atlas via ggbrat", 
               subtitle = "Use `layout = 'fixed'` for reference layer")


library(ggregions)

set_regions(yeo$atlas)


```
